title: Review: Kith entire project deep review
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Review covered all 11 crates with 6 parallel subagents. Uncertainty driven by: (1) kith-tui event.rs is 2000+ lines of async UI state — hard to fully trace all state transitions without running it; (2) no review of web/ client assets; (3) agent hallucinations filtered manually but 3-4 could have slipped through. Would raise confidence with: integration test run against a live tailnet, kith-tui fuzzing of SSE message stream, and review of migrations/ for schema invariants.
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — codebase is well-structured and carefully tested. The two real correctness gaps (backup TOCTOU, accountNotFound non-conformance) are fixable in <2h. The kith-tui module is the largest source of future maintenance burden: 2000+ lines of async state machine with limited test coverage.
